subject: [hw] opus-vdec -> opus-kern/hw-lead: VDEC windows missing for decode (no change asked for the VENC image)
body: The vendor decoder (vdec_drv_init_hw_info @0x1e1b8 in libvcodec_utility.so, sub-block table off its 0x40000 mmap of 0x16000000) addresses pages not in redwood_vcodec.h / p031x: 0x16022000 AVC_VLD (every H.264 syntax element), 0x16024000 PP, 0x16029000, 0x16011800 (LAT_VLD window is only 0x400), 0x16012000, 0x16013000, 0x16014800-0x16017fff, 0x16018800, 0x16001000, 0x16002000, 0x16003800, 0x1600e000; and the larb4/larb5 pages (vendor has vdec_hal_wait/release_larb_sleep_protect). Proposal: ABI rev 3 RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL = 12, base 0x16000000 size 0x30000, page->domain map (0x00000-0x1ffff VDE, 0x20000-0x2ffff VDE2, MDP also needed for larb4 side), larb pages read-only until a host trace (wave3 DEC02) shows which larb offsets the vendor writes. Decoder also needs the racing-word save/restore and HW-break sequence (mtk_vcodec_dec_pm.c:204-288, :296-460) in whoever plays LOCK/UNLOCK; I put that in the AP client (DEC01), not the kernel. Package DEC07 carries the patch text; nothing for the current VENC image.
